title: Pureth in Reth: SSZ Execution Blocks and Query Language
description: This talk will share what we worked on throughout the cohort while implementing the Pureth in Reth project. We will go through our work on withdrawals, receipts, transactions and execution blocks, the process and the problems we faced midway, how the two parts of the project came together and the main learnings we had while working with Reth, SSZ and the Pureth EIPs.
abstract: This EPF project implements selected Pureth components in Reth: SSZ execution objects and roots, along with a query & proof layer for execution data. We will show how these parts come together, how our implementation queries selected data and returns proofs that can be independently verified.
